<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Staff;

use App\Enums\RecordStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\AccessLog;
use App\Models\CumulativeRecord;
use App\Support\StudentRecordQuery;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Form 5 records for counselors (assigned colleges) and the director (all colleges).
 */
class RecordController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $query = StudentRecordQuery::fromRequest($request);

        return view('staff.records.index', [
            'query' => $query,
            'students' => $query->students()
                ->with(['program.college', 'latestCumulativeRecord'])
                ->withExists('entranceTestResults as has_sata')
                ->orderBy('users.last_name')
                ->orderBy('users.first_name')
                ->paginate(20)
                ->withQueryString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Full read-only record. Every view is written to the access log.
     */
    public function show(Request $request, CumulativeRecord $record): View
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $record);

        $this->log($request, $record, AccessLog::ACTION_VIEW);

        $record->load(['student.program.college', 'program.college', 'parents', 'siblings', 'schools', 'organizations', 'reviewer']);
        $sata = $record->student->latestEntranceTestResult()->with(['encoder', 'updater'])->first();

        if ($sata) {
            EntranceTestResultController::logView($request, $sata);
        }

        return view('staff.records.show', [
            'record' => $record,
            'sata' => $sata,
            'sataCount' => $record->student->entranceTestResults()->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function review(Request $request, CumulativeRecord $record): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('review', $record);

        $record->status = RecordStatus::Reviewed;
        $record->reviewed_by = $request->user()->id;
        $record->reviewed_at = now();
        $record->save();

        $this->log($request, $record, AccessLog::ACTION_REVIEW);

        return redirect()
            ->route('staff.records.show', $record)
            ->with('status', 'Marked as reviewed. The student can no longer edit this record.');
    }

    public function photo(CumulativeRecord $record): StreamedResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $record);

        abort_unless($record->photo_path && Storage::exists($record->photo_path), 404);

        return Storage::response($record->photo_path);
    }

    /**
     * Export filtered list of student records as CSV.
     */
    public function exportAll(Request $request): StreamedResponse
    {
        $query = StudentRecordQuery::fromRequest($request);
        $students = $query->students()
            ->with(['program.college', 'latestCumulativeRecord'])
            ->orderBy('users.last_name')
            ->orderBy('users.first_name')
            ->get();

        $headers = [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="student_records_' . date('Y-m-d') . '.csv"',
        ];

        $callback = function () use ($students) {
            $file = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            fputcsv($file, ['Student ID', 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Email', 'College', 'Program', 'Record Status', 'Submitted At']);

            foreach ($students as $student) {
                $rec = $student->latestCumulativeRecord;
                fputcsv($file, [
                    $student->student_number ?? 'N/A',
                    $student->last_name,
                    $student->first_name,
                    $student->email,
                    $student->program->college->code ?? 'N/A',
                    $student->program->code ?? 'N/A',
                    $rec ? $rec->status->value : 'No Record',
                    $rec ? $rec->submitted_at : 'N/A',
                ]);
            }
            fclose($file);
        };

        return response()->stream($callback, 200, $headers);
    }

    /**
     * Export detailed info of a single person/cumulative record as CSV.
     */
    public function exportOne(Request $request, CumulativeRecord $record): StreamedResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $record);
        $this->log($request, $record, 'EXPORT');

        $record->load(['student.program.college', 'parents', 'siblings', 'schools', 'organizations']);

        $filename = 'person_' . ($record->student->student_id ?? $record->id) . '_info.csv';
        $headers = [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
            'Content-Disposition' => "attachment; filename=\"{$filename}\"",
        ];

        $callback = function () use ($record) {
            $file = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            $student = $record->student;

            fputcsv($file, ['=== STUDENT INFORMATION ===']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Field', 'Value']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Student ID', $student->student_id ?? 'N/A']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Full Name', $student->first_name . ' ' . $student->last_name]);
            fputcsv($file, ['Email', $student->email]);
            fputcsv($file, ['College', $student->program->college->name ?? 'N/A']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Program', $student->program->name ?? 'N/A']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Record Status', $record->status->value ?? 'N/A']);
            fputcsv($file, ['Submitted At', $record->submitted_at ?? 'N/A']);
            fputcsv($file, []);

            if ($record->parents->isNotEmpty()) {
                fputcsv($file, ['=== PARENT / GUARDIAN INFO ===']);
                fputcsv($file, ['Relationship', 'Name', 'Occupation', 'Contact']);
                foreach ($record->parents as $p) {
                    fputcsv($file, [$p->relationship ?? 'Parent', $p->name ?? 'N/A', $p->occupation ?? 'N/A', $p->contact_number ?? 'N/A']);
                }
                fputcsv($file, []);
            }

            if ($record->schools->isNotEmpty()) {
                fputcsv($file, ['=== EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND ===']);
                fputcsv($file, ['Level', 'School Name', 'Year Graduated']);
                foreach ($record->schools as $sch) {
                    fputcsv($file, [$sch->level ?? 'N/A', $sch->school_name ?? 'N/A', $sch->year_graduated ?? 'N/A']);
                }
                fputcsv($file, []);
            }

            fclose($file);
        };

        return response()->stream($callback, 200, $headers);
    }

    private function log(Request $request, CumulativeRecord $record, string $action): void
    {
        AccessLog::create([
            'user_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'cumulative_record_id' => $record->id,
            'action' => $action,
            'ip' => $request->ip(),
        ]);
    }
}
